responsibility: Provides the public MVE ACLE type header and reinterpretation helper layer. It triggers frontend registration of the Arm MVE vector and predicate types via #pragma GCC arm "arm_mve_types.h", conditionally defines scalar float aliases for MVE floating-point, and supplies a large family of inline vreinterpret and vuninitialized helpers that convert between the registered MVE vector types without changing bits.
